conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍用小短手搆不到餃子，一顆彈力球在畫面裡亂彈，每撞一下就把一筆撞到位，組成「好」，牠終於吃到「好吃」的餃子。
object: a rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and tiny arms, a bouncy ball in sunny orange, and a plump steamed dumpling
morph: a bouncing ball ricochets around the frame and each hit knocks one stroke into place, building the glyph 好
creativeAngle: 連環彈跳：彈力球每彈一次就撞出一筆，女字旁先、子後；詞「好吃」讓恐龍用大腳把餃子踢進嘴裡。
promptEn: An 8-second springy cartoon clip on a clean solid pale cream-green backdrop, with one large Traditional Chinese glyph 好 as the only text, built of thick glossy saturated magenta strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: a rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything; one supporting object, a bright orange bouncy ball. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 好、好、好吃 (ㄏㄠˇ、ㄏㄠˇ、ㄏㄠˇ ㄔ), slow with clear tones, then stop. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the dinosaur stomps in, squeaking at every step, tries to pick up the bouncy ball with his tiny arms, fails three times as his hands wave short of it, and finally boots it with a giant foot as the first 好 is spoken. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the ball ricochets off the floor, the left wall, the ceiling, and each hit slaps a magenta stroke into place on the left with a bouncy bonk: a curving top stroke, a diagonal sweep, a short horizontal bar, forming the left woman-shaped part. The dinosaur's head whips back and forth following it, eyes rolling. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the ball bounces off his round belly, boing, and rolls over to the right, where two more hits drop in a horizontal bar and a vertical hooking stroke, forming the 子 component; as the second 好 is spoken the glyph 好 completes with a soft rubbery wiggle and the ball plops into the dinosaur's open arms, which he hugs in a clumsy hop. Moment 4 (5s): as 好吃 is spoken, a plump steamed dumpling rolls out of nowhere, the dinosaur tries to grab it with his tiny arms, fails, then kicks it into the air and catches it in his mouth with a gulp, cheeks puffing, eyes squeezed in delight. Final 5–8s: the glyph 好 stays perfectly still and readable while the dinosaur at the side chews happily and gives a thumbs-up with a tiny arm while his big foot taps a calm beat, never touching the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.

conceptZh: 浣熊花生頂著一疊超高的軟泡棉棒，和積木小隊來一場友誼枕頭大戰：兩邊都用力揮空、原地打轉，最後「咚」地撞頭坐倒，飛出去的泡棉棒落成「女」，倒下的積木排成「子」，拼出「好」，兩人握手說「好玩」。
object: a wobbling stack of long squishy cherry-red foam noodles balanced on Peanut's head, and a tower of cherry-red building bricks
morph: the head-bonk flings three foam noodles to the left where they bend into the three strokes of 女, and the brick tower collapses to the right into the three strokes of 子, completing 好
creativeAngle: 全新友誼對決版：不再是恐龍彈力球，也不是靜態大拇指。花生的「疊太高」與「亂敬禮」個性直接變成笑點與筆畫來源：敬禮害疊塔晃、揮空轉圈、撞頭後泡棉棒與積木各自倒成左右兩半，左女右子結構一次看清。詞改用「好玩」，玩字單一讀音，且握手蹦跳的畫面就是「好玩」本身。
promptEn:
An 8-second bouncy cartoon slapstick clip on a clean solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, nothing busy behind. The only text ever on screen is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 好, built from thick glossy saturated cherry-red pieces, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Lead: Peanut, a round cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail and a tiny bellhop cap, balancing a wobbling stack of long squishy cherry-red foam noodles far taller than himself, who salutes at exactly the wrong moments. Buddy: a squad of chunky cherry-red interlocking building bricks that march in step, stack themselves into a tower and topple at the worst time. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no real people. Voice: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 好、好、好玩 (ㄏㄠˇ、ㄏㄠˇ、ㄏㄠˇ ㄨㄢˊ), each syllable slow and distinct with clear tones, then stops.

Moment 1, want it (0–1.6s): Peanut waddles in from the left, stack swaying, and spots the brick squad marching in from the right, which clicks itself into a tower his height holding one foam noodle like a sword. Peanut proudly salutes with his free paw, which makes his whole stack lurch sideways; he catches it with a panicked wobble. The first 好 lands here as both square off, eyes narrowed, foam noodles raised in a cartoon showdown pose.

Moment 2, try and miss (1.6–3.4s): Peanut takes an enormous wind-up, leaning so far back his stack bends like a bow, swings, and whiffs clean over the brick tower, spinning twice from the momentum with his stack whipping around him. The brick tower answers with its own giant wind-up, swings, misses under his nose, and rotates on the spot, bricks rattling and teetering.

Moment 3, the big crash (3.4–5s): both stagger dizzily toward center and bump foreheads with a huge BOINK, squash-and-stretch on impact, then plop down sitting, dazed grins and spinning eyes. The impact launches Peanut's three foam noodles to the left side of the frame where they land and bend into the three strokes of 女: a curving stroke that hooks down and back, a long diagonal sweep crossing it, and a horizontal bar across the middle. At the same beat the brick tower collapses onto the right side into the three strokes of 子: a short horizontal top that bends into a downward diagonal, a tall vertical with a little hook at the bottom, and a horizontal bar through its middle. As the second 好 is spoken the glyph 好 settles with a soft rubbery wiggle, perfectly formed, Peanut and the bricks sitting small at its lower corners.

Moment 4, payoff (5–8s): the glyph 好 holds completely still and readable for the final three seconds. As 好玩 is spoken, Peanut and the top brick reach across the bottom margin and shake hands, then both bounce up into a tiny happy hop-and-high-five jig at the lower right, clearly outside the strokes. In the last half second Peanut snaps one more proud salute, a little late, and the one noodle he still has tips over his cap. Soft even daylight, bright but not neon, no flashing effects, no watermark, no other text.
